messages:
Sam Connors: FYI - FinOpsCo POC update. They want an on-prem deployment behind their VPC and are asking to remove the monthly platform fee for the POC period and a temporary support discount. Need Deal Desk guidance.
Maria Li: How long is the POC commitment window? Do they plan to convert to a full commit after POC?
Sam Connors: POC = 3 months initially, with view to convert to 12 months if successful. Customer expectation: platform fee waived for POC + 30% off Platinum support for first 3 months.
Alex Gonzales: SE notes: On-prem template covers AWS KMS integration but not customer HSM appliance. HSM work will require ~1.5 weeks eng effort and firewall rules need SRE help.
Natalie Perez: We'll need a scoped SOW for the HSM + network setup. Suggest 40 eng hours reserved in month 1. Otherwise bill T&M.
Deal Desk: Provide SKU breakout and ARR run rate so we can calculate concession impact. Also flag whether this is a one-time credit or recurring discount.
Sam Connors: SKU: platform fee = $12k/mo, Platinum support = $9k/mo, reserved GPUs = $22k/mo. List total = $43k/mo -> $516k/yr list. If POC waiver applied to platform fee for 3 months that's $36k. 30% support off (3 months) = ~$8k.
Maria Li: Concession estimate ~ $44k if we do exactly what they ask. Big ask for a short POC. Can we propose an alternate: 3 months platform credit as a one-time $36k credit plus 15% support discount instead?
Deal Desk: Options to consider: (1) One-time platform credit for POC + smaller support discount; (2) Reduced platform fee during POC in exchange for a minimum 12-month commitment after; (3) Keep fees, but provide engineering onboarding credit applied to first invoice. Also need to know revenue recognition impacts for credits.
Legal Bot: Reminder: Any credit >$50k or changes to MSA exhibits for on-prem require Legal + Security review. Also need to add data residency and indemnity language for on-prem nodes.
Security Eng: Quick note on questionnaire: FinOpsCo passed baseline controls but flagged HSM as a must. They provided SOC2 timeline and a diagram for network segmentation. Need to confirm audit log retention and transport encryption for egress.
Natalie Perez: If we include 40 eng hours in contract, we can absorb the HSM work and avoid T&M surprises. I'd include milestone acceptance for the HSM integration in the SOW.
Deal Desk: Preliminary signal: we can approve a 3-month platform credit up to $40k plus up to 20% support discount for the POC if customer signs a 12-month post-POC commitment at a $500k ARR minimum and provides PO. Contingent on Legal/Security signoff and SOW with HSM scope.
Sam Connors: Sounds reasonable. I'll present that to the customer as a counter: "3 months platform credit (one-time) + 20% support discount for POC contingent on 12-month conversion at $500k ARR and signed SOW/PO."
Maria Li: I'll update the deal worksheet and run a sensitivity model for worst/best case conversion.
Alex Gonzales: I'll draft the minimal access matrix and a list of infra changes required for the HSM appliance. Need SRE to confirm firewall rules.
Legal Bot: Sam, send the customer's draft security responses and I'll start MSA exhibit edits. We'll also draft the carveout language for the credit.
Natalie Perez: SOW draft incoming in this thread in ~2h. Will include 40 hours of eng, acceptance steps for POC, and a clause that remaining eng time is T&M at standard rates.
Deal Desk: We'll slot this for exec exceptions queue tomorrow AM. Please attach the worksheet link and the SOW draft in this thread before EOD today.
Sam Connors: Thanks all. Aiming to have customer reply to counter by EOD Monday. I'll post the worksheet link once Maria adds the numbers.
